body:
# Apex 1.21.11 Music Disks



Apex 1.21.11 Music Disks is a vanilla-style resource pack that retextures all Minecraft music disks with clearer designs and stronger visual identity.


Each disk has been carefully redesigned to be easier to recognize at a glance while staying faithful to Minecraft’s original art direction.

Features
- Retextured music disks with improved clarity
- Distinct designs for each individual disk
- Vanilla-friendly colors and style
- 16x resolution to match default textures



Info
Minecraft Version: 1.21.11
Resolution: 16x (Vanilla)

Perfect for players who want music disks that look more polished and readable while keeping the classic Minecraft feel intact.
